title: Credit Control
description:
Credit Controller (Part-Time)

Wrexham Hybrid Working 20 Hours Per Week 12-Month Contract

We're working with a growing and successful business based in Wrexham that is looking to add a Debtors Clerk to its finance team on a part-time basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, keeping accounts on track, and playing a key role in maintaining healthy cash flow. You'll be joining a supportive team where your contribution will make a real difference to the business.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager, you'll be responsible for managing customer accounts, recovering outstanding payments, and ensuring financial records remain accurate and up to date.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing customer accounts and monitoring outstanding balances
- Issuing invoices, statements and payment reminders
- Following up on overdue accounts and maintaining accurate collection records
- Reconciling customer accounts and resolving payment queries
- Processing and allocating incoming payments
- Producing aged debt reports and supporting cash flow activities
- Building positive relationships with customers while ensuring payments are received on time
- Managing customer credit limits
- Processing credit notes and account adjustments
- Handling prepayments and releasing orders where required
- Completing online payment reconciliations

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within credit control, debt recovery, or accounts receivable
- Strong attention to detail and excellent record-keeping skills
- Good problem-solving abilities and a practical approach to resolving issues
- Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, lookups and pivot tables
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to manage your workload independently and prioritise effectively

Desirable Experience
- At least 12 months' experience in a similar role
- Experience using ERP or finance systems
- A good understanding of the full debtor management process

Working Hours

20 hours per week across 5 days, worked flexibly:
- Monday to Thursday between 9:00am and 5:00pm
- Friday between 8:00am and 4:00pm

Contract
- Initial 12-month contract
- Potential for extension or a permanent opportunity

What's In It For You?
- 28 days holiday, including bank holidays (pro rata)
- Company pension scheme
- Private healthcare support
- Free annual eye test voucher
- Free annual flu jab
- Mental health and wellbeing support
- Regular social and team events
- Free on-site parking
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Hybrid working with a minimum of two office days per week

Salary

Competitive salary available upon application.

title: Service Advisor
description:
Service Advisor - NO WEEKENDS

Location: Wrexham

Salary: Up to £32,000 Basic £40,000 OTE

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am - 6pm NO WEEKENDS

Richard Abson Group is recruiting for an experienced Service Advisor / Service Receptionist to join a well-established, premium main car dealership in Wrexham.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Service Advisor looking for a £32,000 basic salary, realistic £40,000 OTE and NO WEEKEND WORK!

You'll be joining a successful dealership offering excellent earning potential, manufacturer training and genuine opportunities for career progression.

The Role:
- Booking vehicles in for servicing, MOTs and repairs
- Keeping customers updated on the progress of their vehicles
- Liaising with Technicians and the workshop to ensure work is completed efficiently
- Advising customers on additional work, repairs and service plans
- Maximising bonus opportunities through upselling and customer service
- Delivering excellent customer service throughout the aftersales process

What We're Looking For:
- Minimum 1 year's experience as a Service Advisor / Service Receptionist within a main car dealership
- Strong customer service and communication skills
- Confident in upselling service plans and additional work
- Experience with Kerridge and 1 Link would be beneficial
- Organised, professional and able to work in a busy dealership environment

Salary & Benefits:
- £32,000 Basic Salary
- £40,000 Realistic OTE
- Uncapped bonus structure
- Existing Service Advisors consistently exceeding bonus targets
- NO WEEKENDS - Every Saturday and Sunday off!
- Monday to Friday, 8am - 6pm
- Manufacturer training and career progression
- Established premium main car dealership

Interested?

If you're an experienced Service Advisor or Service Receptionist looking for a better basic salary, strong bonus potential and the benefit of NO WEEKENDS, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Accountable Recruitment are delighted to be partnering with a growing, UK-based business who are seeking to appoint a Finance Assistant to join their finance team.

Based in Denbigh, this opportunity is ideal for an organised and detail-focused finance professional looking to develop their career within a supportive and expanding organisation. Working as part of a small finance team, you will support a wide range of day-to-day finance and administration activities, ensuring transactions and records are processed accurately and efficiently.

Salary/Benefits
- £27,000 - £29,000 depending on experience
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Modern office facilities with refreshments provided
- Free on-site parking
- 28 days annual leave, increasing with service
- Additional leave entitlement over the Christmas period
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Annual salary review
- Paid sickness allowance
- Company social events

Job Duties
- Process daily banking transactions and accurately allocate customer receipts
- Support Direct Debit collections and investigate payment discrepancies
- Maintain sales ledger records and respond to customer account queries
- Process customer refunds and maintain supporting documentation
- Assist with supplier payment runs and invoice verification
- Support purchase ledger activities and other routine finance tasks
- Maintain accurate electronic records and financial documentation
- Respond to finance-related queries from customers, suppliers and colleagues
- Provide general administration support across the wider business
- Assist in identifying process improvements within finance and administration functions

Who will I report in to?
- Senior Finance Team Member

When will interviews be taking place?
- Interviews will be taking place as suitable applicants are identified

Ideal Experience
- Previous experience within an accounts, finance administration or similar role
- Experience processing financial transactions and maintaining accurate records
- Strong numerical ability and attention to detail
- Competent user of Excel and finance systems
- Well organised with the ability to manage deadlines effectively
- Professional communication skills and a customer-focused approach
- Sage 50 or Sage 200 experience would be advantageous
- AAT qualified or studying towards AAT would be beneficial, although practical experience is equally welcomed
